campaign.name: The Shattered Crown
campaign.description: The Ember Crown has vanished from the royal vault. Strange storms spread across the kingdom, and the party must discover who stole it before the winter solstice.

characters.name: Seraphina Vale
characters.inventory: Longbow, twin daggers, 2 healing potions, ancient compass
characters.abilities: Hunter’s Mark, Cure Wounds, Extra Attack
characters.description: A royal scout tracking the stolen Ember Crown.

characters.name: Brom Ironvale
characters.inventory: Warhammer, shield, chain mail, smithing kit
characters.abilities: Second Wind, Action Surge, Extra Attack
characters.description: A former royal guard seeking redemption.

characters.name: Lyra Ashford
characters.inventory: Spellbook, arcane focus, scroll of protection
characters.abilities: Fireball, Mage Armor, Detect Magic, Misty Step
characters.description: A scholar who suspects the crown is part of an ancient seal.

quests.title: Find the Ember Crown
quests.description: Follow the stolen crown from the royal vault to the ruined observatory.

quests.title: The Missing Archivist
quests.description: Locate Archivist Thorne before the cult reaches him.

quests.title: A Debt in Stonebridge
quests.description: Earn the trust of the bridge wardens.

notes.title: Previously on The Shattered Crown
notes.description: The party found a silver key beneath Stonebridge and discovered a map marked with three stars.

notes.title: GM Secret: The True Thief
notes.description: The royal adviser staged the theft to break the seal beneath the observatory. Reveal this only after the party finds the coded ledger.

events.title: Session 3: The Ruined Observatory
events.description: Explore the observatory and investigate the star map.

events.title: Winter Solstice
events.description: The ancient seal weakens at midnight.

activity.message: The party discovered the silver key under Stonebridge.
